items.text: Count returned players, check numbered sleeves; date count in green ledger. If one is missing, note its number and last-seen time; tell desk lead before leaving; leave check incomplete. If desk lead is absent, enter “pending lead review” in ledger and notify building manager before locking up; manager cannot authorise disposal or replacement. Initial only if all devices are present and counted.
